title: Somnium Engine — deterministic counterfactual narrative engine (architecture spec)
description: Somnium Engine (SE) is a sibling project of Kronos Engine (KE) that models fictional canons as structured worlds (entities, facts, causal edges, constraints) and derives the consequences of canon interventions deterministically. Core question: what happens to a fictional world when something in its canon changes? KE is an architectural ancestor only; no code is shared; KE is not modified.
key_decisions: World state is derived, not stored: Branch stores canonId + ordered Intervention[]; derive(canon, interventions) is a pure memoized function.
Narrative time is a partial order over events via PRECEDES edges; no tick loop, no wall clock.
Causal edges are typed (REQUIRES, ENABLES, MOTIVATES, PRECEDES, EXCLUDES, INVARIANT) evaluated by a monotone fixpoint over a status lattice.
Status lattice: UNKNOWN < UNSUPPORTED < CONTINGENT < ESTABLISHED; EXCLUDED incomparable; CONTRADICTORY at top. ALTERED is NOT a status; alteredness lives in the diff.
Rewind Points are canonical cuts (downward-closed event sets) anchored to a canon event, with derived-hash tamper detection.
Counterfactual depth = genealogical depth (parent chain) + divergence score (structural change); inheritance of depth-N state is structural via derive().
Interventions are a closed typed vocabulary (negateEvent, forceEvent, setFact, retractFact, severEdge, addEdge, relocate) to enable future minimum-intervention search.
Zero stochasticity in v1 core: no RNG, no Monte Carlo statistics, no LLM. LLM allowed only at canon ingestion boundary and optional narration of computed diffs.
Contradictions are first-class ContradictionRecords with provenance; never auto-repaired.
One generic typed WorldDiff with typed projections (CharacterDiff, EventDiff, RelationshipDiff, LocationDiff, FactionDiff, WorkDiff, CanonDiff).
acceptance_criteria: derive(canon, interventions) is deterministic: same canon + same interventions => identical WorldState (replay test).
Depth-N world inherits complete state of depth-N-1 except explicit intervention overrides.
Contradiction fixtures yield CONTRADICTORY status + ContradictionRecord; engine never silently repairs.
Core package has zero LLM/network imports (CI-enforced).

Verrin seed-library PoC demonstrates all 10 capabilities: baseline canon, one Rewind Point, one intervention, causal propagation, changed character state, changed event reachability, branch genealogy, world diff, multi-depth intervention, deterministic replay.
references: ../Kronos Engine (ancestor, read-only; not modified - separate repository)
